reproducibility_finding.severity: worth logging, not a live defect
reproducibility_finding.detail: Re-running `bun run build` locally (this session, same commit) regenerates public/sitemap.xml with the SAME 88 URLs but DIFFERENT lastmod dates, route ordering, and priority/changefreq values than the live production sitemap.xml. The generator's own documented design computes lastmod from real git history per route, falling back to 'today' when no match is found -- the local checkout in this environment appears to hit that fallback for routes where the CI-produced live sitemap has genuine historical dates (e.g. 2026-08-02, 2026-08-12). This means: (a) the live sitemap is correct and unaffected, (b) local rebuilds in this specific working-directory are not a reliable oracle for 'what the next CI build will produce' for this one artifact specifically.
